intent_scope.boundary: No grounded-stage, final-art, commercial, or animation inference.

review_rule: Research acceptance requires every applicable hard assertion and an authorized timed human review; agent visual triage is non-gating.

assertions.requirement: Use only fictional adult character design inputs; no real-person/adult-likeness input or child data.
One undivided comic panel with declared composition; final lettering is evaluated through a separate layout artifact.
Soren retains pale oatmeal work coat and Sigrid retains practical plaid wrap unless an explicit future panel plan revision says otherwise.
The pair leave the farmhouse before the damp grass dries. Composition requirement: wide downhill departure; two small adult figures against the trail.
Sigrid checks the smoke direction against the folded map. Composition requirement: over-shoulder map insert; smoke mark circled.
Soren notices that the boot prints now overlap the trail rather than lead it. Composition requirement: low track detail with Soren's boot held back.
They exchange a look and continue without explaining the change. Composition requirement: two-shot, stopped in opposite thirds of frame.
Rainwater feeds a shallow runnel across their path. Composition requirement: horizontal environmental insert, no people.
Sigrid steps the runnel first and points out an older stone marker. Composition requirement: side view, Sigrid foreground, Soren waiting behind.
The marker bears a simple mill-wheel sketch, not a name. Composition requirement: close stone texture and carved circle.
Soren folds the map to hide the farmhouse and expose the creek line. Composition requirement: hands and map; no face required.
The trail narrows under wet branches. Composition requirement: long narrow path; Sigrid leads, Soren follows.
Sigrid hears the water before it is visible. Composition requirement: close profile listening into blank dark woods.
Soren finds a length of soot-stained twine caught on a thorn. Composition requirement: hand insert, twine against wet thorn.
The twine points downhill as if pulled taut and released. Composition requirement: diagonal line across empty trail.
They follow the creek instead of the tracks. Composition requirement: rear wide; paired figures on a descending bank.
The smoke briefly disappears behind a shoulder of ridge. Composition requirement: distant landscape, no people.
Sigrid marks the loss of sight on the map with a wet thumb. Composition requirement: map close; thumb obscures the line.
Soren says the smoke must be closer than it looks. Composition requirement: two adults walking without facing each other.
The abandoned mill appears below, roofline broken against pale morning. Composition requirement: establishing wide; mill, creek, no people.
Smoke rises from behind the mill rather than from its chimney. Composition requirement: telephoto environmental detail.
Sigrid signals Soren to stay off the open bridge. Composition requirement: Sigrid foreground hand signal, Soren held back.
They cross the creek on stones below the bridge. Composition requirement: high angle, separated stepping rhythm.
A freshly tied strip of red cloth moves from a lower branch. Composition requirement: cloth insert, background deliberately unreadable.
Soren stops Sigrid from touching the cloth. Composition requirement: hands nearly meet but do not touch the marker.
They circle toward the mill's collapsed loading door. Composition requirement: side tracking composition through grass.
A thin smoke thread rises from a metal drum hidden behind stone. Composition requirement: revealing insert; no people.
The drum contains only wet pine needles and a damp ember. Composition requirement: close overhead discovery.
Sigrid tests the heat without disturbing the ember. Composition requirement: hand held above drum; smoke separates fingers.
Soren sees a second twine line disappearing through the mill wall. Composition requirement: Soren at left, line exits right into darkness.
The line is tied to a small brass bell inside the doorway. Composition requirement: bell insert, still and silent.
Sigrid chooses the wall opening rather than the doorway. Composition requirement: low angled entry; Soren watches the exterior.
Inside, daylight bars stripe standing water and broken gears. Composition requirement: interior establishing panel, no people.
Sigrid finds dry footprints ending at the water's edge. Composition requirement: foreground tracks, her crouched silhouette.
Soren sees the footprints begin again on the far side, facing back. Composition requirement: deep perspective across water.
A quiet drip rings the brass bell once from outside. Composition requirement: both adults freeze in different depths.
Neither moves toward the bell. Composition requirement: held wide, doorway as empty negative space.
Sigrid notices a sealed tin on an upper beam. Composition requirement: upward view; tin isolated in daylight.
Soren reaches it with a fallen plank while Sigrid braces the plank. Composition requirement: two-person practical cooperation, no spectacle.
The tin holds dry matches, a hand-drawn creek map, and a blank note card. Composition requirement: object spread on stone.
The map marks the farmhouse with a small square and the mill with a circle. Composition requirement: map close; two deliberate symbols.
A third mark is visible upstream, beyond the map edge. Composition requirement: Soren's finger stops at torn paper edge.
Sigrid decides the smoke was a signal, not a campfire. Composition requirement: close adult profile, calm deduction.
The hidden drum finally goes out in the rain. Composition requirement: smoke thinning above wet metal.
The bell rings again, now from the creek side. Composition requirement: empty doorway and a single taut line.
They leave the tin open on the stone and retreat together. Composition requirement: rear two-shot, careful backward motion.
At the creek, Soren cuts the twine line with a pocket knife. Composition requirement: hands, blade, taut twine.
The distant bell does not ring after the cut. Composition requirement: quiet creek and mill exterior.
Sigrid keeps the creek map inside her wrap rather than the notebook. Composition requirement: wardrobe/prop continuity close.
They climb back toward the farmhouse under a cleared sky. Composition requirement: wide uphill silhouettes, no smoke visible.
From the ridge, the farmhouse is visible but its chimney has begun to smoke. Composition requirement: distant house as destination; no people.
Soren realizes they did not light the stove before leaving. Composition requirement: Soren foreground, house far beyond.
Sigrid breaks into a run toward the house; Soren follows with the map. Composition requirement: final wide directional rush, two adult figures, house ahead.
